That candidate was dA/dt ≈ −0.094 t² + 2.75 A − 0.174 t/A + 0.058 t²/A − 0.297 A² − 0.743. The rate is strongly time-dependent and changes sign. At A≈1 it falls roughly linearly from +2 at t≈1 to −3.3 at t≈10. At t≈8.5 it is large and positive at low A and turns negative at higher A.
